part.Name: Description
part.Short: Fur and rawhide hang loose from the wooly, scaly hide of the small theropod's muscled back. Their eyes gaze both languorous yet sharp. They walk on stout yet powerful legs, yapping a drawl whose crocodilian rattle is almost beyond your understanding.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Large drapes of cloth cover the giant woolen reptile and giant bracelets wrap around their tree trunk like arms. For a moment they stand upright from their quadraped gait. Their deep rumbling voice shaking the bones of those around them.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The stone mask and glass eyes grown from the anomaly's face see all. It's presence resonates and hums with the strings of the universe nearby. Yet still, reality tremors when the winged being speaks in its true voice.

part.Name: Render
part.DisplayName: Salt Dune Temperate Orm Axe Thrower

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Clad in glimmering teal steel, spiteful eyes gaze upon those who do not abide the cult of the wheel. their quiet chants to the ofuth from which they hail hide a fanatical rage. The ofuth needs more spokes to labor in the bilor.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The hulking cyan armored tank on all fours shakes the earth as their shields crush it. Their deep, heavy breaths can be heard from afar as silent prayers push up against them. They will ensure new bodies arrive to the ofuth so that the wheel can be turned one day more.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Azure scales with touches of charcoal pigment caress the wise mages. A soft hum of an ancient mantra, resonates from their jaws.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Yellow scales and rounded ears mark the drek with curiosity. Strong and bold, she stands ready to challenge even the strongest Dralk. Be it bronze or yatal, she forges the strongest gear she knows.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Elden black scales cover this once fellow traveler. His feet hooved, and cracked, but still resound. What stories does this elder drek have to tell?

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Charcoal pigmented scales embrace the elder orm. As once strong, now weakened by age. She once was forced to craft basic supplies, but has undergone retirement.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Elden scales coat this wise drek. Her bold stature, gives off an ancient omen. She speaks a language native to this planar.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Bathed in shimmering cold, her breath spreads out from her grand maw. Her dense fur coat swathes about her form, as she moves. Her stance is fours between twos, together in a momentary stand.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Golden scales meet silver fangs. Teal steel adorned in heretical fashion. What mayest be their curious passion?

part.Name: Description
part.Short: What stands large and tall carries a thundering shot. This was Hishkla's calling. To protect her family, as she left her clan to rubble.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A panting snout and a weary smile, the weary traveler rests his bead covered gonne across his back, covered in hides and pouches. They look as though they have found a lot of stories under their feet.
